items.name: Children's Cancer Hospital 57357
items.what: Large specialist hospital in Cairo with a big clinical pharmacy department.
items.tip: Oncology and IV preparation experience is valued here. Check its careers page regularly.

items.name: Cleopatra Hospitals Group
items.what: Group of private hospitals in Cairo and Giza.
items.tip: Apply for clinical or inpatient pharmacist roles and mention your hospital systems experience.

items.name: Alameda Healthcare (Dar Al Fouad, As-Salam International)
items.what: Owns Dar Al Fouad in 6th of October and Nasr City, and As-Salam International in Maadi.
items.tip: Accredited hospitals like these value medication-safety and clinical pharmacy work.

items.name: Andalusia Hospitals
items.what: Private hospital group with hospitals in Cairo.
items.tip: Check which of its hospitals are in Greater Cairo before applying.

items.name: EVA Pharma
items.what: Large Egyptian pharma manufacturer, with roles in production, quality, regulatory and sales.
items.tip: Look at its regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance and quality roles.

items.name: EIPICO
items.what: Egyptian pharma manufacturer. Its main site is in 10th of Ramadan City, outside Greater Cairo.
items.tip: Look for roles at its Cairo offices, such as regulatory affairs and pharmacovigilance.

items.name: Amoun Pharmaceutical
items.what: Egyptian pharma manufacturer.
items.tip: Look at its quality, regulatory and pharmacovigilance roles.

items.name: Hikma
items.what: Regional pharma company with operations in Egypt.
items.tip: Set a job alert for Egypt on its careers site.

items.name: Pfizer careers
items.what: Its Cairo office hires medical, regulatory and quality staff. The daily search already checks it.
items.tip: Create a profile and a job alert for Egypt so you hear about new roles straight away.

items.name: Novartis careers
items.what: Its Egypt office and factory hire pharmacists. The daily search already checks it.
items.tip: Look for Egypt early-career programmes as well as normal job posts.

items.name: AstraZeneca careers
items.what: Its Cairo office hires medical, regulatory and commercial staff. The daily search already checks it.
items.tip: Medical information and regulatory roles often prefer a pharmacy degree.

items.name: IQVIA careers
items.what: The largest clinical research company. It has many pharmacovigilance and clinical trial roles.
items.tip: Search for "Drug Safety Associate" and "Medical Information". Hospital experience helps with both.

items.name: Thermo Fisher (PPD) clinical research
items.what: Clinical research jobs, including remote roles based in Egypt.
items.tip: Filter by Egypt. It has posted Clinical Trial Coordinator roles there.

items.name: ICON careers
items.what: Large clinical research company with pharmacovigilance and medical information roles.
items.tip: Set an alert for pharmacovigilance roles in the Middle East and Africa.

items.name: Parexel careers
items.what: Clinical research company with drug safety and regulatory roles.
items.tip: Look at its entry-level and graduate roles.

items.name: PrimeVigilance
items.what: A company that specializes in pharmacovigilance and hires drug safety associates remotely in many countries.
items.tip: A GCP or pharmacovigilance certificate helps your CV stand out.

items.name: WHO careers
items.what: World Health Organization jobs, consultancies and internships, including in its Cairo regional office.
items.tip: WHO's Eastern Mediterranean office is in Cairo. Look for medicines, supply and health-product roles.

items.name: UNICEF jobs
items.what: UNICEF has supply, health and immunization roles. The daily search already checks it.
items.tip: Create a profile and save searches for Egypt and "health".

items.name: Good Clinical Practice course (NIDA)
items.what: A free online Good Clinical Practice course with a certificate.
items.tip: Add the certificate to your CV and LinkedIn. CROs often ask for GCP.

items.name: OpenWHO courses
items.what: Free WHO online courses on public health, medicines and emergencies.
items.tip: Short courses with certificates look good for UN and NGO applications.

items.name: WHO Academy
items.what: WHO's learning platform for health workers.
items.tip: Look for courses on medicines safety and supply.

items.name: Wuzzuf job alerts
items.what: Egypt's main job site. It blocks this tool, so its own alerts fill the gap.
items.tip: Create free alerts for "clinical pharmacist", "pharmacovigilance" and "صيدلي إكلينيكي" in Cairo and Giza.

items.name: Bayt job alerts
items.what: Job site across the Arab region. It also blocks this tool.
items.tip: Create alerts for pharmacist jobs in Cairo and Giza.

items.name: LinkedIn job alerts
items.what: Pharma companies and CROs in Egypt post many jobs here first.
items.tip: Set alerts for "clinical pharmacist Cairo", "pharmacovigilance Egypt" and "regulatory affairs Egypt".

items.name: Forasna
items.what: Egyptian job site popular with pharmacy chains.
items.tip: Search for "صيدلي إكلينيكي" in Cairo and Giza.

items.name: Unified Procurement Authority
items.what: Egypt's central buyer of medicines and medical supplies for public hospitals, based in Cairo. It employs many pharmacists in procurement, supply and quality.
items.tip: A strong fit for supply chain and procurement experience. Check its site and LinkedIn page for vacancy announcements.

items.name: Egyptian Drug Authority
items.what: Egypt's medicines regulator. It posts its own vacancies and the regulatory rules companies follow.
items.tip: Reading the registration rules here helps in regulatory affairs interviews.
